passages.context_header: GitLab BV (Netherlands) Benefits > Growing Families Leaves > Long-Term Care Leave

statements.text: You can take up to 6 times your weekly hours per year (for example, 240 hours for full-time employees) for long-term care leave due to the serious, life-threatening illness of a child, partner, or parent.
This leave is unpaid, but it runs concurrently with PTO, which provides 100% pay for the first 25 days.

passages.context_header: Product Development Flow > Release stages guidelines

statements.text: Teams should release features as generally available from the start unless there are strong reasons to release them as experimental, beta, or limited availability first.

passages.context_header: Ethics and Compliance Courses > Courses

statements.text:
When you join, you are enrolled on your start date in the following courses:

- Ethics and Code of Conduct
- Insider Trading
- Public Disclosure Training
- Global Data Privacy

Depending on your department or role, you may also be enrolled in:
- Anti-Bribery and Corruption (for team members in Finance, Legal & Corporate Affairs, Marketing, and Sales)
- Government Contracting: Gifts, Gratuities, and Bribery (for team members employed by or working with our public sector entity)
- Technology Control Plan (for team members employed by or supporting GitLab Federal)

passages.context_header: The GitLab Procurement Team > Large Internal Events Process

statements.text: The planning stages for large internal events with a total cost greater than $1M should be completed at least 18-24 months prior to the actual event.

passages.context_header: Accounts Payable > General Guidelines

statements.text: Accounts Payable will pay "Urgent Payment" requests in the next available payment run, provided the invoice has been fully approved in ZIP.
However, AP cannot accommodate same-day payment requests.

passages.context_header: HackerOne Process > Step-by-Step Triage and Remediation Procedure > Awarding Ultimate Licenses

statements.text: Yes, GitLab reporters with 3 or more valid reports are eligible for a 1-year Ultimate license for up to 5 users.
Reporters request the license through a comment on one of their issues.

passages.context_header: GitLab GmbH (Germany) information & benefits > Family & Leave Transitions > Family Care Support

statements.text:
The duration of leave to care for a family member depends on the type of care needed:

* **Emergency care:** Up to 10 days for acute situations.
* **Short-term care:** Up to 6 months of full or partial leave.
* **Long-term care:** Up to 24 months of partial leave, with a minimum of 15 hours per week.
* **End-of-life support:** Up to 3 months for accompaniment.

passages.context_header: Growth and Development Fund > Tax implications

statements.text: Whether Growth & Development reimbursements are taxable depends on your location and circumstances.
In some countries, they may be considered taxable income, and team members should check the country-specific tax table or contact Payroll with questions.
For team members in the United States, reimbursements are generally not considered taxable income when used for qualifying work-related education expenses, though individual circumstances may vary.

passages.context_header: Our stewardship of GitLab > Contributing A Not-Yet-Existing Feature

statements.text: It will be accepted under whatever license (open-source or source-available) you prefer, provided that the contribution has met the contribution acceptance criteria and GitLab Inc. has not already started working on the feature.

passages.context_header: Webcasts > Speaker Approval

statements.text:
To line up a subject matter expert to present a webcast, follow these guidelines:

* Prepare a high-level abstract of the content before asking for a presenter.
* Send the abstract to the proposed speaker and their manager for review.
Ensure you get manager approval, as the speaker is not considered booked without it.
* Address and resolve any concerns about the abstract.
* Once the speaker accepts and their manager approves, you may move forward with the webcast.

passages.context_header: GitLab Ireland Ltd > Health & Wellbeing > Eye Care

statements.text: Yes, GitLab provides up to €140 reimbursement for computer glasses if they are medically required for VDU use only.
To claim, you must submit your eligible costs through VHI first, submit the remaining receipts via Navan, and email your prescription to total-rewards@gitlab.com.

passages.context_header: Executive Connect events

statements.text: All team members who are within approximately 60 minutes of the host city are welcome to attend Executive Connect events.

passages.context_header: Coverage and Scheduling > What If My Shift Gets Reassigned?

statements.text:
If your shift gets reassigned due to circumstances such as a sick call-out, changing business priorities, or a schedule error, the following things happen:

* You will receive notification, typically via Slack or from your rotation leader.
* You might swap with someone else, or an override may be created to reassign the period.
* You should receive reasonable notice unless an emergency occurs.

passages.context_header: GitLab Canada Corp > Time Away & Leave > Paid Time Off & Vacation

statements.text: You should coordinate with your manager at least twice as many days in advance as the total days requested (for example, providing 6 business days of notice for 3 days off).

passages.context_header: Vulnerability Management > Vulnerability Management Standard

statements.text: Vulnerabilities must be fixed within SLA timeframes, unless an exception exists.

passages.context_header: Laptop Wipe (Factory Reset) Process

statements.text: Under no circumstance should you perform your own disk wipe unless you are doing so at the request of IT to troubleshoot a technical problem with the laptop.
Otherwise, laptop wipes must be performed by scheduling an appointment with an IT analyst.

passages.context_header: Customer Success Plans > When is a Success Plan required

statements.text:
A Customer Success Plan should be initiated in the following situations:

* An opportunity has completed Stage-3 Technical Evaluation with a technical win.
* First Order opportunities for accounts with a LAM over $2M in the Proposal stage (Stage-4) and beyond.
* All New or Growth Opportunities over $100k net ARR, in the Proposal stage (Stage-4) and beyond.
* All existing customers with upcoming Renewals over $100k in ARR basis.
Additionally, SA Managers have the discretion to include or exclude additional opportunities.

passages.context_header: Learn How to Use Chorus.ai > What is a Chorus Tracker and How do I Create One?

statements.text:
How you get a Chorus Tracker created depends on your role:

* **Managers:** Submit an issue in the Sales Operations project using the Chorus Tracker Request template.
* **Individual contributors:** Sync with your manager and have them submit the request.

passages.context_header: Cadence Calls > Frequency

statements.text: CSMs should hold cadence calls weekly during onboarding.
Otherwise, cadence calls should be held at least biweekly, taking into account the customer's specific needs and stage in their lifecycle.

passages.context_header: Downtime Credits > Eligibility Requirements

statements.text:
To be eligible for downtime credits, a customer must meet **all** of the following conditions:

* Have a new or renewed Ultimate subscription with a start date after 2025-12-01 on GitLab.com or GitLab Dedicated, or have a documented exception in their org notes.
* Experience downtime that resulted in monthly uptime below 99.9%.
* Submit a claim within 30 days after the affected month ends (and only after the affected month has ended).
* Have not previously submitted a claim for the same month.

passages.context_header: The GitLab Procurement Team > What are the exceptions to the PO Policy?

statements.text:
The exceptions to the PO Policy are:

* One-time purchases under $5K (or less than $5K annually)
* Charitable Contributions (Donations)
* Interview Candidate Reimbursement
* Confidential outside counsel legal fees
* Confidential Recruiting Engagements
* Statutory Tax fees
* PEO Providers
* AR/Customer Refunds
* Board of Director Payments
* Financing, Banking and Investing (incl interest, debt, FX, fees)
* Corporate Credit Card
* Urgent Payments not included on list above (approval required from VP, Corporate Controller and/or PAO)
* Business Insurance (Urgent Payments)
* Benefits
* Emergency Assistance Services

passages.context_header: Marketing > Getting help > Sponsorship

statements.text: Yes, GitLab considers organizational or project sponsorships when there is a marketing benefit.
Typically, these sponsorships are provided in kind, such as developer time commitments or subsidized/free GitLab licenses.
Cash sponsorships for projects or organizations are considered only in exceptional cases, such as when a project or organization that GitLab depends on is struggling to survive financially.
